summary: Time-of-day field wrapping the native time input, with a label, supporting text and range checks; the value is a 24-hour time string.

usage.text: value is a 24-hour "HH:MM" or "HH:MM:SS" string whatever the display format, and the form receives it under name. Any other string fails validation, and its message shows while invalid is set.
step is in seconds, default 60, so only hours and minutes are edited. Use step="1" to edit seconds, or e.g. 900 for 15-minute arrow-key steps.
min and max are times within one day; a value outside them fails validation, and its message shows while invalid is set. A range that crosses midnight is not supported.

a11y.text: While invalid, the shown error (error-text or the native validation message) replaces supporting-text and is linked to the native input as its description.
